This lesson covers Sign Reading 6.2.1 Phonic awareness (s-z), part of MY SCHOOL Strand Sub Strand Specific Learning Outcomes Suggested Learning Experi in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / PP1 General.

Core competencies:

• Communication and collaboration: The learners collaboratively articulate all letter sounds in preparation for reading.

Self-efficacy: The learner confidently and correctly chants, sings and recites letter sounds.

• Social justice: The learner together with others work co-operatively to compete in letter sounds recognition games.
